p:dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The declared product is a building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) facade cladding manufactured by SolarLab.dk ApS. The nominal power per 1 m² is 140.35 Wp. The declared product has two functions: (i) to produce electricity and (ii) facade cladding in the building envelope. Moreover, the declared product can be customized to fit the specific design and aesthetic requirements of the building, with options for different colors, shapes and finishes. In order to account for the fact, that the BIPV façade elements are manufactured on a project basis (i.e. customized between projects) the material composition of the product represents an average product for the year 2022. Note that the electricity production (B6) from the photovoltaic laminate is site specific to the building project and should therefore be calculated seperately i.e. it is not accounted for in the dataset.
